claims.name: LinearInputSupportComposition.support_targets_monotone
claims.claim: 任意の V、u<v、u が a を支持し v が b を支持すると a≤b。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem support_targets_monotone (V : ℝ → ℝ) (u v a b : ℝ) (huv : u < v)
    (hu : ∀ x : ℝ, u * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a)
    (hv : ∀ x : ℝ, v * (x - b) ≤ V x - V b) :
    a ≤ b

claims.name: LinearInputSupportComposition.support_input_interpolation
claims.claim: 同じ a を支持する二入力 u,v の凸結合 (1-t)u+tv も a を支持する。0≤t≤1。

theorem support_input_interpolation {V : ℝ → ℝ} {a u v t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)

    (hv : ∀ x : ℝ, v * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, ((1 - t) * u + t * v) * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a

claims.name: LinearInputSupportComposition.unique_minimum_of_strict_support_interpolation
claims.claim: u が a を厳密に支持し v が非厳密に支持すると、0≤t<1 で凸結合入力の唯一の大域最小点は a。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem unique_minimum_of_strict_support_interpolation {V : ℝ → ℝ} {a u v t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    (hu : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≠ a → u * (x - a) < V x - V a)
    (hv : ∀ x : ℝ, v * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, energy V id ((1 - t) * u + t * v) a ≤
      energy V id ((1 - t) * u + t * v) x) ∧
    ∀ b : ℝ, (∀ x : ℝ, energy V id ((1 - t) * u + t * v) b ≤
      energy V id ((1 - t) * u + t * v) x) → b = a

claims.claim: u≠v で a,b がどちらも両入力に支持されるなら a=b。

theorem common_support_targets_eq {V : ℝ → ℝ} {a b u v : ℝ} (huv : u ≠ v)
    (hua : ∀ x : ℝ, u * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a)
    (hub : ∀ x : ℝ, u * (x - b) ≤ V x - V b)
    (hva : ∀ x : ℝ, v * (x - a) ≤ V x - V a)
    (hvb : ∀ x : ℝ, v * (x - b) ≤ V x - V b) :

claims.name: LinearInputQuarticClassification.global_minimizer_iff_of_margin_zero
claims.claim: λ>0、余裕0、設計入力のときの全平面大域最小点集合は正確に反射する二点（原点では一致）。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem global_minimizer_iff_of_margin_zero {lam r a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hmargin : lam * a ^ 2 + r = 0) (x y : ℝ) :
    (∀ z w : ℝ, E lam r (input lam r a) x y ≤ E lam r (input lam r a) z w) ↔
      (x = a ∨ x = -a) ∧ y = Real.sqrt 2 * x

claims.name: LinearInputQuarticClassification.strict_support_iff_input_and_unique_margin
claims.claim: λ>0。厳密支持 iff 設計入力かつ (正余裕 または a=r=0)。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem strict_support_iff_input_and_unique_margin {lam r u a : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, x ≠ a → u * (x - a) <
      (lam * x ^ 4 / 4 + r * x ^ 2 / 2) -
      (lam * a ^ 4 / 4 + r * a ^ 2 / 2)) ↔
    u = input lam r a ∧ (0 < lam * a ^ 2 + r ∨ (a = 0 ∧ r = 0))

theorem unique_global_minimum_iff {lam r u a : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :

claims.name: LinearInputCurvatureRigidity.forced_phase_minimum_rigidity
claims.claim: k≠0、C²曲率、開区間上の実際の強制曲率方程式、一つの内点の相状態が全平面で大域最小なら、区間全体で曲率一定かつκ′=0。入力0を含む。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem forced_phase_minimum_rigidity {k sigma u a b s₀ : ℝ}
    {kappa : ℝ → ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        sigma * kappa s = k * u)
    (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hmin : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa s₀)
        (deriv kappa s₀ + sqrt 2 * kappa s₀) ≤
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u x y) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, kappa s = kappa s₀ ∧ deriv kappa s = 0

claims.name: LinearInputCurvatureRigidity.forced_phase_not_minimum_of_nonconstant
claims.claim: 同じ曲率方程式・正則性・k≠0で、曲率が区間上非一定なら、全内点の相状態は大域最小ではない。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem forced_phase_not_minimum_of_nonconstant {k sigma u a b : ℝ}
    {kappa : ℝ → ℝ} (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ 2 kappa)
    (heq : ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b,
      k * deriv (deriv kappa) s + k * (kappa s) ^ 3 / 2 -
        sigma * kappa s = k * u)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, kappa s = K) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo a b, ¬ ∀ x y : ℝ,
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u (kappa s)
        (deriv kappa s + sqrt 2 * kappa s) ≤
      E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) u x y

claims.name: LinearInputCurvatureRigidity.locallyMinimizing_phase_minimum_exclusion
claims.claim: ℓ>0,k>0,C³接線角、実際の面積拘束付き局所最小性、非一定曲率のもと、同じp,σ,cで曲率方程式・相エネルギー保存・全相状態の大域最小性の排除を得る。圧力0を含む。
claims.exact_lean_statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_phase_minimum_exclusion {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {k ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hk : 0 < k) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hmin : LinearInputAreaMinimum.LocallyMinimizing k θ ℓ)
    (hnonconst : ¬ ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s = K) :
    ∃ p sigma c : ℝ,
      LinearInputPressureStationary.Stationary k p θ ℓ ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (k * deriv (deriv (deriv θ)) s + k * (deriv θ s) ^ 3 / 2 -
          sigma * deriv θ s = p) ∧
        E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
          (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) = c ∧
        (¬ ∀ x y : ℝ,
          E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) (p / k) (deriv θ s)
            (deriv (deriv θ) s + sqrt 2 * deriv θ s) ≤
          E (1 / 2) (-sigma / k) (p / k) x y)
